acceptanceCriteria: Inventory of Setpgid spawners reachable from adapter/hook paths; each is recorded in the live registry or documented as unreachable from an exiting adapter; the xcrun owned-worker case stays inside the worker group; a test proves an adapter exit kills a recorded non-Git group.
body:
Found during V1-0734 (batch L, 2026-10-08). After V1-0734, KillLive at adapter os.Exit kills child groups recorded in the groupreap live registry. Other spawners that create private groups with Setpgid (tools, testrunner, tasks and others) are not recorded, so if the adapter watchdog or event deadline calls os.Exit while they run, their groups outlive the adapter. Related residual windows recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-08-batch-l-integration.md: a foreign reaper (ECHILD) can collect a recorded leader before KillLive, and platforms without waitid keep a post-reap signal. Review P2 (lane-0734): internal/gitstatus/executable.go:78 creates a private group even after EnableOwnedWorker(), so on Darwin with /usr/bin/git an xcrun child escapes the enclosing worker group.

Independent review dad48885..cc2378cb (Darwin, 2026-10-09): P2 at internal/procgroup/process.go:361. On ECHILD, the newly registered leader remains in liveGroups throughout BeforeStop and group cleanup, unlike groupreap.waitHeld immediate failure release. A concurrent exitProcess can therefore signal a reaped/reused numeric PGID even after failed observation is known. Scratch Go overlay reproduction: Run a shell exiting 0; AfterStart uses Wait4(pid) to reap; BeforeStop first confirms waitProcessExitUnreaped(pid)==ECHILD then inspects the live registry under its mutex. TestReviewECHILDReleasesBeforeStop fails: reaped leader remains registered after ECHILD, during BeforeStop. Expected: failed observation promptly releases the record and performs no numeric termination, with regression coverage. Correct build-log line 103 immediate-release claim. Existing focused Darwin race tests pass; TestAHI049ExitProcessKillsProcgroupGroup fails on base overlay in 60.06s and passes at head. Windows vet passes. This confirms stale registration, not observed actual PGID reuse.

title: Adapter exit does not kill Setpgid groups outside the groupreap live registry
